name: Java 21 + Spring Boot 3
summary: Re-platform ASP.NET / WCF / worker / library code onto Spring Boot 3 services (Java 21, virtual threads). Web UIs (MVC views, Razor Pages, Web Forms) become a REST API plus a separate front end, or server-side Thymeleaf when a like-for-like UI is required.

stack.Framework: Spring Boot 3.x (Spring Web MVC, virtual threads enabled)
stack.Persistence: Spring Data JPA (Hibernate 6) + Flyway migrations; JdbcClient for hand-written SQL
stack.Messaging: Spring for Apache Kafka, Spring AMQP, Spring Cloud Stream where broker-agnostic is preferred
stack.Caching: Spring Cache abstraction (Caffeine local, Redis distributed)
stack.Testing: JUnit 5, AssertJ, Mockito, Testcontainers, Spring Boot Test slices, ArchUnit

projectLayout: <app>-domain/                   entities, value objects, domain services, business rules (no Spring deps)
<app>-application/              use cases (one per legacy flow), ports (interfaces)
<app>-infrastructure/           JPA repositories, messaging adapters, cache, external clients
src/test/.../parity/            characterization tests replaying legacy golden cases
conventions: Package by capability (one module/package per ReLearn capability slug), hexagonal ports & adapters inside.
Constructor injection only; no field injection. Map legacy DI lifetimes: Singleton→singleton bean, Scoped→request-scoped work inside a @Transactional use case, Transient→prototype only if stateful.
Every legacy business rule becomes an explicit domain method or validator named after the rule; annotate tests with the BR id (@Tag("BR-0001")).
Use BigDecimal with explicit MathContext/RoundingMode to match .NET decimal semantics (MidpointRounding.ToEven ⇒ RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN; AwayFromZero ⇒ HALF_UP).
Map .NET DateTime → java.time (LocalDateTime/OffsetDateTime/Instant) deliberately; record time-zone decisions in research.md.
Translate legacy exceptions to RFC 7807 ProblemDetail responses with equivalent status codes and messages.
Async .NET (Task/async) maps to plain blocking code on virtual threads; use CompletableFuture only at true fan-out points.
testing: Characterization (golden-master) tests per legacy flow must pass before a capability is cut over.
Testcontainers for the real database engine and brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis) in integration tests.
Contract tests (Spring Cloud Contract or Pact) for every legacy endpoint and message.
ArchUnit rules enforce module boundaries and that domain has no framework dependencies.
Mutation testing (PIT) on rule-heavy domain code.
nonFunctional: p95 latency no worse than legacy baseline; measure with the same scenarios.
12-factor configuration; secrets from Vault / cloud secret manager.
Container image via Spring Boot buildpacks; health/readiness probes via Actuator.
